items.text:
I want to review this block by Jovaughn Gwyn posted by @VocalVike.

Gwyn has a solo block against Domonique "Big Citrus" Orange who I had ranked #13 among all IDL this draft (my scouting notes are attached as a reply).  I have a 4th for par and 5th for value on him, but the Vikings drafted him at #82 out of Iowa State.  

The point being: Orange is no slouch.  He is supposed to be a space-denying, 2-gap NT who creates plays for others.

Gwyn did something so rare, it deserves mention...he solo blocked a NT off the LoS 5+ yards and then pancaked him.

Even a nasty C does this perhaps a handful of times per season if at all. Tyler Linderbaum, who is one of the best run-blocking centers in the NFL, had just 19 solo pancakes all of last season with 7 occurring at the LoS on run plays (2 Chi, 1 Cle, 2 NYJ, 2 NE, I will go back and look at these 7 plays).

After Pinter's injury, Gwyn appears to be the most likely #Ravens starting C for the opener.
